note: Historical event template data. Sources resolve against scenario sources[].

events.title: Operation Crusader opens
events.body: Eighth Army advances west from Mersa Matruh and crosses into Libya near Fort Maddalena. Storms the night before ground aircraft on both sides.
events.effectsNote: Restates N02: storms on 17/18 Nov grounded aircraft on both sides; duration game-scale.

events.title: Bir el Gubi and Sidi Rezegh
events.body: 22nd Armoured Brigade fights the Ariete Division at Bir el Gubi; 7th Armoured Brigade reaches Sidi Rezegh airfield.

events.title: Tobruk breakout
events.body: The 70th Division breaks out towards Ed Duda while heavy fighting begins around Sidi Rezegh.

events.title: Totensonntag
events.body: 15th Panzer overruns the 5th South African Brigade near Sidi Rezegh; both sides lose heavily.

events.title: Rommel's dash to the wire
events.body: Rommel takes direct command of the Afrika Korps and Ariete and drives towards the Egyptian frontier to cut off the British.

events.title: Cunningham replaced by Ritchie
events.body: Lt-Gen Neil Ritchie takes over Eighth Army.

events.title: Tobruk relieved
events.body: The New Zealand Division links up with the Tobruk garrison near Ed Duda, but Rommel turns the Afrika Korps back towards Tobruk.
events.effectsNote: Restates N02 (link-up with the garrison, 27 Nov) and N05 (Tobruk supplied by sea during the siege): the besieged port keeps its throughput share from the link-up. besiegedShare is the engine default (game-scale).

events.title: Rommel orders the retreat
events.body: Rommel orders a retreat west; Neumann-Silkow is mortally wounded. The Axis occupy the Gazala positions by 8 December.

events.title: Bardia, Sollum and Halfaya ordered to hold
events.body: Axis garrisons on the frontier are ordered to hold as long as possible.

events.title: Fighting at the Gazala line
events.body: Eighth Army attacks the Gazala line; on 15/16 December Rommel orders it evacuated.

events.title: Italian warships carry fuel to Libya
events.body: Fuel is carried to Derna and Benghazi by Italian warships; the Luftwaffe is limited to about one sortie per day.

events.title: Axis hold Ajedabia-El Haseia
events.body: The Axis hold a line between Ajedabia and El Haseia for about ten days after the retreat.
